subject: [PATCH v8 21/30] mm/madvise: skip PMD swap entries for MADV_COLD and MADV_PAGEOUT

2026-10-02.patch_summary: This patch optimizes the handling of PMD swap entries for MADV_COLD and MADV_PAGEOUT operations in the Linux kernel's mm/madvise module. It skips unnecessary processing when a swapped-out huge page (THP) has no resident folio to deactivate or reclaim, preventing potential issues with migration or device-private entries. The patch introduces a check for PMD swap entries before attempting to map PTE tables, ensuring efficient and correct handling of these operations.
